title: Sections over an algebraically closed point are exact on the pro-etale site
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], whose final object is $\operatorname{id}:s\to s$. Then the functor $\Gamma(s,-):\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F(s)$ from abelian sheaves on $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to abelian groups is exact: every surjection of abelian sheaves $\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ gives a surjection $\mathcal F(s)\to\mathcal G(s)$. Consequently, for every sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal A$ on $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the functor $\Gamma(s,-)$ from $\mathcal A$-modules to $\Gamma(s,\mathcal A)$-modules is exact; applied termwise to complexes it preserves quasi-isomorphisms, so it induces a functor $\Gamma(s,-):D(s_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal A)\to D(\Gamma(s,\mathcal A))$ commuting with shifts and carrying distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles, and $H^i(\Gamma(s,K))=\Gamma(s,\mathcal H^i(K))$ for every $K$ and $i$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].
